name: Dialog
description: A modal dialog overlay that renders content centered on the viewport. Built on @radix-ui/react-dialog with animated overlay (bg-black/80 fade) and content (zoom/slide transitions). Includes a built-in close button (X icon) in the top-right corner of DialogContent. Composed of sub-components for structured layout.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state of the dialog.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: The default open state when uncontrolled.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Event handler called when the open state changes.

props.name: modal
props.description: Whether the dialog blocks interaction with the rest of the page.

subComponents.name: DialogTrigger
subComponents.description: The element that opens the dialog when clicked.

props.name: asChild
props.description: Merge props onto the child element instead of rendering a default button.

subComponents.name: DialogPortal
subComponents.description: Portals the overlay and content into document.body.

props.name: container
props.description: The container element to portal into.

subComponents.name: DialogOverlay
subComponents.description: A semi-transparent overlay behind the dialog content. Uses bg-black/80 with fade-in/fade-out animations.

subComponents.name: DialogClose
subComponents.description: A button that closes the dialog. Can be used anywhere within DialogContent.

props.name: asChild
props.description: Merge props onto the child element.

subComponents.name: DialogContent
subComponents.description: The centered modal content container. Renders inside a portal with an overlay. Max width is lg (32rem). Includes an automatic close button (X icon) in the top-right corner with 'Close' as sr-only text. Features zoom and slide animations on open/close.

subComponents.name: DialogHeader
subComponents.description: Layout wrapper for the title and description. Stacks vertically with space-y-1.5. Centered text on mobile, left-aligned on sm+ breakpoints.

subComponents.name: DialogFooter
subComponents.description: Layout wrapper for dialog actions. Uses column-reverse on mobile, row with right-alignment on sm+ breakpoints.

subComponents.name: DialogTitle
subComponents.description: The title of the dialog. Rendered as text-lg font-semibold with tight leading and tracking.

subComponents.name: DialogDescription
subComponents.description: A description providing context below the title. Styled as text-sm text-muted-foreground.

accessibility.role: Uses role='dialog' on the content element. The overlay prevents interaction with elements behind the dialog.
accessibility.keyboard: Escape closes the dialog (returning focus to the trigger). Tab and Shift+Tab cycle focus within the dialog. Focus is trapped inside the dialog while open.
accessibility.aria: aria-labelledby is automatically set to the DialogTitle id. aria-describedby is automatically set to the DialogDescription id. The built-in close button has a sr-only 'Close' label.
accessibility.notes: Unlike AlertDialog, Dialog closes when clicking on the overlay. The close button (X icon) is always rendered inside DialogContent. Follows the WAI-ARIA Dialog Pattern.

examples.title: Controlled dialog
examples.code:
<Dialog open={isOpen} onOpenChange={setIsOpen}>
  <DialogContent>
    <DialogHeader>
      <DialogTitle>Confirmation</DialogTitle>
      <DialogDescription>Are you sure you want to proceed?</DialogDescription>
    </DialogHeader>
    <DialogFooter>
      <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => setIsOpen(false)}>Cancel</Button>
      <Button onClick={handleConfirm}>Confirm</Button>
    </DialogFooter>
  </DialogContent>
</Dialog>
